findings.claim: The new RuntimeError-only boundary falsely classifies every other escaping exception as a programming error. Three ordinary malformed-artifact inputs make the unmodified current-master nhap_wd raise zlib.error, OSError or LZMAError with a correct REST archive digest. R7 explicitly forbids assigning those inputs any K8 state. An executor following it must let the evaluation escape instead of producing the complete three-state/reason/mode result required by I4, §4.3 and the journal contract. The nine new examples and their mutants do not close this cause class.

whole_candidate_scan.result: K2/K5 already define unreadable files abstractly and do not impose this RuntimeError-only exclusion. evidence.observed_output: Healthy stored/deflate/bzip2/lzma controls -> passed. deflate_corrupt -> zlib.error("invalid block type"), bzip2_corrupt -> OSError("Invalid data stream"), lzma_properties_corrupt -> _lzma.LZMAError("Invalid or unsupported options"). All three have runtime_subclass=false and R7 model escapes; each archive digest is recomputed before calling the real helper.

Seven topology/JSON examples -> wd_khong_hop_le:c:zip. Unsupported compression -> NotImplementedError; encryption -> RuntimeError; deeply nested JSON -> RecursionError. All three latter classes are RuntimeError subclasses and are covered by R7. A deliberately missing transport key raises KeyError and remains a programming-error control.

3/3 malformed-compression observations fail their own named case assertion under the R7 boundary model; 3/3 pass the input-error oracle with valid-compression controls. KeyError control passes without blanket conversion; catch-everything mutant fails ProgramErrorCase. No unrelated exception is credited as a kill.
evidence.unmeasured: The adapter is a literal spec model, not B3 product code. Actual B3 script/journal behavior cannot be run before implementation.

evidence.observed_output: Helper blob 086f416921c3df1b2e81d95f509e04c6a9d573ae. ZIP block catches only BadZipFile, ValueError and KeyError. Its escaped decompressor errors are caused by byte input, without monkeypatching the helper.

findings.scope_decision: The upstream helper already had these escape paths. This is not a request to fix that out-of-write-set module. B3 is introducing a new adapter whose frozen contract promises complete classification of this same artifact boundary and now expressly mislabels input errors. Therefore the missing B3 rule is an in-scope continuation of SPEC-20, not unrelated pre-existing product debt. KeyError from a programming fault can remain outside the result contract. RecursionError needs no additional rule because R7 already catches RuntimeError subclasses.

suggested_fix.where: Revise SPEC.md §4.3 at the helper-call exception boundary, its part-state mapping, acceptance 5/11 and the closure/history statement. Eventual adaptation belongs in ops/cong_phat_hanh.py; ops/ci_provenance.py remains unchanged and outside the write set. This is the boundary B3 owns.
suggested_fix.how: Define an explicit policy for the measured external-byte decoder errors as well as RuntimeError. The least invasive option extends the documented K8 error mapping to these input-error families, preserving truthful unknown state/reason and both mode outcomes; avoid a blanket Exception catch. Keep programming-error controls separate and constrain any OSError handling so unrelated bugs are not silently reclassified. A more elaborate bounded byte-decoding boundary could distinguish proven-invalid input from inability to measure, but would require extra parsing and is not necessary merely to close these observations. Runnable reproducers: probe_a4.py and lock_a4.py in the review scratch directory.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Use real ZIP bytes and recomputed REST digests for deflate, bzip2 and lzma corruption, each with its own case exception and corresponding valid-compression control. Assert all eight K8 parts, primary reason, chan rc/no push, and warning_only classification/journal. A mutant reverting to RuntimeError-only and a mutant omitting each newly covered input family must fail the intended case; a catch-everything mutant must fail the separate KeyError propagation case. The executed lock_a4.py demonstrates those distinctions at the frozen-boundary model level; the executor must rederive the actual B3 tests.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Overbroad OSError/Exception conversion can conceal code defects; duplicate ZIP reads can introduce inconsistent bytes or extra downloads; unsupported decoder availability can differ by Python/OS. Preserve digest binding, no-dispatch behavior, phase truthfulness, case-owned mutant attribution and native-platform coverage.
